changes: FIX v1.3.0: table thead under .table-scroll overflow-x:auto could not stick to viewport and vanished on page scroll. Move the real sortable thead into a unified top sticky panel outside scrolling container.
Freeze title/subtitle, controls, sorting dropdown, 7D overview and all six clickable table-heading columns as one group; no duplicate table heading while scrolling.
Retain DOM for hidden group filters and search to avoid breaking original app.js; retain all stock/crypto side rails and symbol navigation.
Keep the frozen table headings horizontally synchronized with the body and measure sticky height so sidebar jumps do not hide symbol rows.
Make the top control area sticky: merge the title/subtitle strip into the floating command block and keep it pinned at the viewport top while scrolling the charts.
Hide the green-crossed items from the UI (group filter buttons and search field) without removing their DOM nodes, preserving existing app initialization and data logic.
Keep sorting and status controls accessible at the top while charts scroll; make the table header stay directly beneath the floating controls and update row scroll offsets for jump navigation.
Tighten the visual stack so the sticky block reads as one merged panel with shared borders and background, reducing wasted space above the table.

Top-align left/right floating symbol rails at 8px from the viewport edge (formerly 100px desktop / 125px compact); increase scroll-list viewport height without changing item sizing, symbols, navigation, prices, chart logic or other features.
FIX: Quote CL in symbols.js tokenized watchlist. The bare identifier CL threw ReferenceError before LIQ_SYMBOLS was created, leaving all rows and both new floating navigation panels at zero.
Preserve every configured production watchlist symbol (27 crypto and 12 tokenized/commodity) without overwriting personal watchlist choices.
Cache-bust symbols.js through ?v=1.2.8 and update the visible version badge. All existing 4H, 1D, CoinGlass, markers, alert and navigation logic remains unchanged.
Add floating crypto and tokenized-stock/commodity navigation rails using symbols.js watchlist groups; show fresh quotes from existing in-page records without new API calls.

Clicking a sidebar item smoothly scrolls to its original symbol row and briefly highlights it, regardless of the table sort. When a filter/search hides the symbol, reset to all and reveal it automatically.
Keep sidebars visible while scrolling; current symbol is highlighted. On narrower viewports collapse rails into expandable edge tabs to avoid obscuring charts.
Preserve all 4H charts, daily signals, 7D liquidity, persistent color flags, Telegram bells, and existing refresh intervals.

Show TradingView-like 4H OHLC open/high/low/close values at the upper-left of every chart; default to the current unfinished 4H candle, inspect historical 4H candles only while the cursor is over those bars, and restore current on mouse exit.

Show a live right-axis crosshair price label for the mouse Y coordinate whenever the pointer moves inside the plot; keep the true price independent of CoinGlass/NOW or HA levels and display in the three empty right-side candle slots.
Preserve S-state, 1D BB(20,2), 1D midline/CCI/HA, 7D liquidity, 4H candles, alerts, colors, HA click-to-expand, and existing refresh frequency.

FIX: Daily BB(20,2) now reaches the current 4H candle by projecting an in-progress 1D candle from today's 4H OHLC, replacing its unfinished daily close with a fresh live quote; retain 19 previous real daily closes and the shared population-stdev algorithm.

Daily indicator badges (S-state, midline slope, HA and CCI) and BB chart now use this same 1D projection, including when the 1D provider has not yet returned today's candle. At Asia/Taipei 08:00 a new daily candle begins; past candles never change.
No changes to 4H candle timeframe, CoinGlass levels, NOW, visual styling, notifications, color marks, or existing market-data polling frequencies.

Make ONLY the clicked daily HA (yellow/purple average-K) price label background fully opaque (fill-opacity: 1), hiding any underlying NOW/CoinGlass labels; leave existing NOW and CoinGlass label transparency, HA guide transparency and all indicator calculations unchanged.

Dismiss a click-selected daily HA extension immediately when pointer leaves the selected HA stair (in date or Y position), the plotting area, or the chart itself; also handle SVG replacement during live redraw.
Render bullish 4H bodies with a translucent teal fill (~28%); bearish bodies stay hollow. Candle wicks remain outside the body.
Subtly fade CoinGlass/NOW label backgrounds and edges, thin and fade level dash lines; soften selected HA extension guide and right-side numeric price badge.
Keep all original 1D indicators, real 4H OHLC, real 7D boundaries, and existing alarm and marker behavior unchanged.
Render real 4H up and down candle bodies as transparent hollow rectangles; draw wicks as two separate segments outside each body.
Use TradingView-inspired near-black charcoal chart background with low-contrast grid, date tick and price-axis colors.
Only clicking directly on a 1D HA yellow/purple step reveals its same-color dashed price extension and right-axis value; moving the mouse alone never displays HA price.
Pointer leaving the chart clears transient HA selection; 10-second live redrawing retains the selected HA step while pointer remains inside.
Preserve 4H-only OHLC, 1D BB(20,2), 1D midline/S state/HA/CCI, original CoinGlass 7D levels, three blank candle slots, alert and color-mark features.
Only actual 4H OHLC candlesticks use the 4H timeframe; BB(20,2), BB midline slope, S state, daily HA staircase, and CCI-SMA are all calculated from genuine 1D candles.

Daily Bollinger follows the same SMA(close,20) with population stdev*2 algorithm as shared monitor-engine.js; daily bands are plotted as one 1D value per day across the 4H time coordinate, NOT recalculated from 4H closes.
Right-axis CoinGlass/proxy upper/lower tags show prices only; NOW tag retains NOW prefix; dollar signs removed from all chart and radar headline price labels.
Remove both chart-bottom microtext descriptions and omit 08:00 from bottom date ticks; the Asia/Taipei 08:00 daily alignment still applies internally.
Reduce visual prominence of 4H candles, BB upper/mid/lower to emphasize liquidation levels and daily HA steps.
Reserve exactly three blank 4H candle slots to the right of the latest OHLC for breathing room before the price badges.
Preserve realtime refresh intervals, shared daily indicator engine, original 7D CoinGlass / proxy, alarm and color-mark sorting features.
New real 4H OHLC candle chart with Bollinger(20,2) upper/middle/lower overlay and TradingView-style right-side price axis and dashed vertical Taiwan-time grid.
7D CoinGlass / explicit proxy levels and 10s NOW quote drawn as true-price horizontal lines with independently positioned right labels; retain existing source-fallback logic.
Remove old compact radar and BTC probability display, retain live daily S-state, daily midline slope, daily HA color transition, CCI-SMA, price-alert bell and persistent color marks.
4H history refreshed every four minutes, daily at 12-minute cadence, NOW from existing 10-second quotes, CoinGlass from existing 60-second refresh.
No worker/backend changes required; original monitor and homepage remain untouched.
Color each HA yesterday/today text independently: previous 黃 in yellow, previous 紫 in purple, current 黃 in yellow, current 紫 in purple; show first-day color changes clearly.
No changes to dailyHA source/calc, SState, CCI, CoinGlass 7D levels, probability engine, Telegram or color marks.
Add 顏色標記集中 sorting to the existing dropdown: marked symbols first, grouped in fixed red/orange/yellow/green/blue/purple order, followed by unmarked symbols.
Keep original watchlist item numbers and symbol-linked marks; within each same-color group preserve the original watchlist order.
Automatically regroup while this sort is selected whenever local colors change or Cloudflare R2 restores marks; preserve all other sort methods and marker persistence.
Frontend-only change: the existing color-marks Worker API requires no update.

Add six persistent TradingView-like color flags to the first index column. Clicking the number opens a palette with six colors and a clear option; clicking an already-selected palette color also clears it.
Bind each original index number and color mark to its Pionex symbol, not the current sorted row position; sorting, filtering, and live refresh preserve the matching flag.

Cache marks in localStorage and synchronize via the existing Cloudflare Worker R2 bucket terminal/radar_color_marks.json. The upgraded Worker is needed for cross-device sync; without it, local marks still persist on that browser.
No changes to CoinGlass, CMC, probability calculations, sorting algorithms, Telegram alert monitoring or existing R2 data keys.
Resize the Fear & Greed desktop card to reach approximately the bottom of row 7, while calculating width from the original aspect ratio.
Keep the enlarged proportional card clamped inside the liquidation table boundary and visible viewport.
Resize the Fear & Greed desktop card to reach approximately the bottom of row 6, while calculating width from the original aspect ratio.
Clamp the enlarged proportional card within the liquidation table boundary and viewport on every open, resize and scroll.
Show only the CMC index line in the card: remove BTC price, BTC volume, their API calls, and the crossed-out explanatory note; keep direct manual refresh and official-data provenance.
Keep the original radar 7D liquidation, prices, 39-feature probabilities, sorting, Telegram alerts and all existing data workflows unchanged.

Display OT-UP / OT-DN / OTHER in S-state column using exactly SStateMonitorEngine.classifyOtherExtension (shared homepage 0.85/0.15, 2-of-3 continuation rules), with semantic colors, full-name tooltips and sorting.
Switch CoinGlass max-pain request range from '24h' to '7d' (one week).
Update radar source labels and heading to 7D/1週, while preserving independent 15M proxy fallback.
Keep the existing BTC short-horizon probability model unchanged; do not present percentages as calibrated seven-day touch probabilities.
Keep Pionex live prices, SState signals, sorting, Telegram alerts and custom symbols.js unchanged.
Move the NOW price label flush to the right edge of the liquidation column.
Shift upper and lower boundary labels left and narrow them to avoid overlap when prices are close.
Keep the existing three-line liquidation radar, sorting, probabilities and Telegram alert bell unchanged.
Explicit up-cross / down-cross direction selection for every price alert
Verify a true crossing using two Worker-observed prices and persist armed/last_price in R2
Avoid first-poll threshold false positives due to delayed browser quotes
Keep original one-shot Telegram and Cloudflare scheduled checks, existing symbols and radar calculations
Add a Telegram alert bell beside each symbol in the integrated liquidity radar
Reuse SState Market Terminal Cloudflare /api/monitor/alerts and its shared R2 / Telegram credentials; price alerts persist when browser closes and are removed by Worker after successful send

Synchronize bell states from the shared Worker every 30 seconds and on visibility return; check enabled alerts every 10 seconds while radar is open, existing Worker cron continues every minute after closing
Use the original Pionex symbol identity including WTI_USDT_PERP so existing Monitor and Radar see the same alert; requires optional Worker WTI->TradingView CL mapping upgrade for WTI alerts
Keep user-edited symbols.js, liquidation levels, probabilities, indicators and sorting unchanged
